About Us

Road & industrial marking for Gulf projects

Gulf Seismic General Contracting L.L.C. provides road and facility marking services from Abu Dhabi, UAE, with Saudi Arabia coverage through Seismic Contracting Company LLC. Work covers roads, highways, parking, airports and industrial facilities — quoted to the client’s drawings, materials and municipal specifications.

Our Mission

To deliver durable, specification-led road and facility marking for clients across the UAE and Saudi Arabia — with clear scope, controlled evidence and responsive quotation support.

Our Vision

To be a trusted marking contractor for transport, commercial and industrial clients who need clear documentation, safe execution and accountable follow-through.

Our Standards

  • Quality and HSE management systems (details on request)
  • Municipal / client approvals per project specification

Specific certificates and vendor registrations are confirmed per tender. See company profile PDFs under Downloads where retained.

Our story

Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Abu Dhabi, Gulf Seismic began as a specialist thermoplastic road marking contractor serving the UAE. Today we deliver highway, parking, warehouse, airport, industrial, safety signage and epoxy flooring work across service cities in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

Our delivery approach emphasises clear scope, safe site practice and verification against the client's approved specification — whether the work is a corridor marking package or a facility deck.

Evidence-backed project documents retained from our legacy site (and listed on the Projects pages) support specific delivered works. Broader portfolio metrics are confirmed from controlled records on request rather than restated as marketing totals here.

What we do

Road Marking

Hot-applied thermoplastic and cold plastic road line marking for highways, urban roads and access roads — quoted to the client’s municipal specification.

Thermoplastic Road Marking

Hot-applied thermoplastic line marking offering superior durability, reflectivity and adhesion — the preferred system for highways and high-traffic roads.

Parking Lot Marking

Precision parking bay line marking, accessibility stencils, direction arrows and pedestrian walkways for malls, offices and residential towers.

Warehouse Marking

Industrial floor marking for warehouses — pedestrian walkways, forklift lanes, hazard zones, storage bays and OSHA / HSE compliant safety zones.

Airport Marking

Runway, taxiway and apron marking compliant with ICAO Annex 14 — including threshold bars, holding positions, centrelines and guidance signs.

Industrial Marking

Chemical and heat-resistant floor marking for factories, refineries and plants — hazard zones, equipment zones, pipe identification and safety walkways.

Safety Signage

Manufacture and install safety signage, traffic signs, hazard signs, wayfinding and regulatory signage compliant with local and ISO standards.

Epoxy Flooring

High-build epoxy, polyurethane and self-levelling floor systems for warehouses, factories, parking decks and commercial spaces — seamless and chemical resistant.
